descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The knights are coming - and you have blasters from the future.

Castle puts you on the walls of your own moated castle. Waves of knights and red-caped captains march out of the forest and charge up the road with their swords out. Your job: hold the gate.

- A whole castle to defend: walls, towers, a keep, a market courtyard and a drawbridge over a wide moat
- Ride the lift up to the lookout tower, jump up onto the ledge for a better shot, or walk out through the gate - it opens for you and nobody else
- The Chrono Arsenal: 18 futuristic blasters on a weapon wheel - sidearms, rifles and heavy guns
- Hold the trigger and every gun fires full auto
- Wave after wave, each one bigger than the last - your best wave is saved
- Captains, gate repairs between waves, a wave banner in the sky and a wrist board with the gate's health
- Start menu, pause menu, how-to-play card and a soundtrack you can switch on or off
- Smooth 72 fps with snap turning, played standing

How many waves can you hold?
